source: measured on BDS 1.26.51 with the bds-sweep blocks job (redstone and fire scenarios), 2026-10-30 UTC

conventions.arena: stone floor at y=-61 (x -10..24, z -12..24), survival player standing on it (feet y=-60), noon, clear sky, peaceful (fire steps name their difficulty); the redstone scenarios run at randomtickspeed 0, fire at randomtickspeed 1 with doFireTick on
conventions.faces: 0 down, 1 up, 2 north (-z), 3 south (+z), 4 west (-x), 5 east (+x)
conventions.placement: levers, repeaters, comparators, buttons, torches and doors are clicked into place by the player (steps with action "use"); dust, lamps, plates, note blocks, stone, redstone blocks and fire are /setblock
conventions.ticks: the watched cells are read once per server tick; tick 0 is the tick in which the trigger cell (the clicked lever/button/comparator, or the pressed plate) was first seen changed, or the tick of the command when a step has no trigger; a change at tick n was first seen n ticks after tick 0; tick_0_server_tick is a running server tick count, so steps can be compared for even/odd phase
conventions.changes: per tick, the watched cells that changed and their new state in block state notation
conventions.samples: fire: every samples_every ticks, the watched cells per block name (air only counted)
conventions.packets: sounds and level events received by the player after the step started, identical ones merged with a "times" count; block runtime ids in sound data are written as the block state they denote; block_update_packets counts the block update packets
